'''Osmotic fields''' were a form of protective field in use by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The field could controlled and set to block substances or creatures passing through the area it covered. A model released around 20 BBY could also drain energy from air molecules passing through the field and so lower their temprature. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeons]] [[Jos Vondar]] and [[Zan Yant]] slept in a cubicle during their time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]], where they were stationed to treat [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] wounded in [[Battle of Drongar|battle]], which had an entrance sealed with an osmotic field. The field was set to allow air through but not a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Insect/Legends|insect]] native to the planet known as [[wingstinger]]s which were considered a pest. Vondar requisitioned a field of the newer temperature controlling field and hoped to receive it before the end of the war.

==Behind the scenes==
Osmotic fields first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', the first novel in the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published in [[2004]].
